answers: Dave is broader than a frontend or backend label. He is a Senior Creative Technologist who works across JavaScript, WebGL, Node.js, Three.js, physical computing, and real-world interactive installations.

You could call Dave frontend-adjacent, full-stack-adjacent, or experiential, but the cleaner title is Senior Creative Technologist. He builds interactive software that often has to run in physical spaces.
Dave works across the stack when the project needs it, but his strongest association here is creative technology: JavaScript, WebGL, interactive installations, and rapid prototypes.
